package com.github.e0ipso.tokkl.api

import java.io.IOException

/** The outcome of one API call. */
sealed interface ApiResult<out T> {
    data class Success<out T>(val value: T) : ApiResult<T>

    data class Failure(val error: ApiError) : ApiResult<Nothing>
}

/** Why an API call failed. */
sealed interface ApiError {

    /** The server answered with a status outside 2xx. */
    sealed interface Http : ApiError {
        val status: Int
    }

[credential-related line omitted]
    data object AuthFailed : Http {
        override val status: Int get() = 403
    }

    /**
[credential-related line omitted]
     * Tokkl. [retryAfterSeconds] is null when `Retry-After` is missing or not
     * a whole number of seconds.
     */
    data class RateLimited(val retryAfterSeconds: Long?) : Http {
        override val status: Int get() = 429
    }

    /**
     * Any other status outside 2xx. [message] is the server's reason when the body is a JSON
     * string, as Tokkl sends for a change it refuses, such as "Name has already been taken", and
     * null for any other body.
     */
    data class UnexpectedStatus(override val status: Int, val message: String? = null) : Http

    /**
     * No HTTP response arrived: no route, DNS failure, refused connection,
     * TLS failure or timeout. Not an [Http] error.
     */
    data class Network(val cause: IOException) : ApiError

    /** A 2xx response whose body is not the expected JSON. */
    data class InvalidResponse(val cause: IllegalArgumentException) : ApiError

    /**
     * The request, or a redirect, pointed at [origin] (`scheme://host:port`),
     * which is not the configured server, so nothing was sent there. Carries
     * no credential.
     */
    data class HostNotAllowed(val origin: String) : ApiError

    /**
     * The request was refused before any credential left the phone, because
     * the server failed a trust check. A signed-in session shows it on every
     * screen.
     */
    sealed interface TrustRefused : ApiError

    /**
     * A [TrustRefused] the user can answer: the user has not agreed to trust
     * the server, and the answer to the matching prompt lets the next request
     * through.
     */
    sealed interface TrustQuestion : TrustRefused

    /**
     * [server] is a plain `http://` URL the user has not confirmed, so the
     * request, which would have carried the credentials unencrypted, was not
     * sent.
     */
    data class CleartextNotConfirmed(val server: ServerUrl) : TrustQuestion

    /**
     * No system or user CA trusts the server's [certificate], and the user
     * has not pinned it. [changed] is true when the user pinned another
     * certificate for that server. The TLS handshake failed, so nothing was
     * sent.
     */
    data class UntrustedCertificate(val certificate: ServerCertificate, val changed: Boolean) : TrustQuestion

    /**
     * The server's certificate does not name [host], the host of the URL,
     * in its subjectAltName, so OkHttp's host name check refuses it, also
     * when the user pinned it. Nothing was sent. No answer from the user
     * lets a request through: the certificate has to name the host, or the
     * URL has to use a host it names.
     */
    data class CertificateHostMismatch(val host: String) : TrustRefused
}

function SortHeader({ label, name, sort, dir, update, numeric = false }: {
  label: string;
  name: SortKey;
  sort: SortKey;
  dir: SortDir;
  update: (patch: ReportPatch) => void;
  numeric?: boolean;
}) {
  const active = sort === name;
  const next: SortDir = active ? (dir === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc') : name === 'description' ? 'asc' : 'desc';
  return (
    <th scope="col" className={numeric ? 'num' : undefined} aria-sort={active ? (dir === 'asc' ? 'ascending' : 'descending') : 'none'}>
      <button type="button" className={`sort-button${active ? ' active' : ''}`} onClick={() => update({ sort: name, dir: next })}>
        {label}
        <span className="sort-arrow" aria-hidden="true">{active ? (dir === 'asc' ? '▲' : '▼') : ''}</span>
      </button>
    </th>
  );
}

function sortDetailed(entries: ReportEntry[], orderBy: unknown, orderDir: unknown): ReportEntry[] {
  checkOrderBy(orderBy);
  const dir = String(orderDir ?? 'DESC').toUpperCase() === 'ASC' ? 1 : -1;
  const sorted = [...entries];
  switch (orderBy ?? 'date') {
    case 'date':
    case 'user':
      sorted.sort((a, b) => dir * (a.start.localeCompare(b.start) || a.id - b.id));
      break;
    case 'duration':
      sorted.sort((a, b) => dir * (a.seconds - b.seconds || a.id - b.id));
      break;
    case 'description':
      sorted.sort((a, b) => dir * (a.description.localeCompare(b.description) || a.id - b.id));
      break;
    case 'last_update':
      sorted.sort((a, b) => dir * (a.at.localeCompare(b.at) || a.id - b.id));
      break;
  }
  return sorted;
}

function v3Weekly(entries: ReportEntry[], user: UserRow, weekStart: string) {
  const rows = new Map<string, ReturnType<typeof emptyWeeklyRow>>();
  function emptyWeeklyRow(entry: ReportEntry) {
    return {
      user_id: user.id, user_name: user.fullname, project_id: entry.projectId, project_name: entry.projectName,
      project_color: entry.projectColor, project_hex_color: entry.projectColor, client_name: entry.clientName,
      planned_task_id: null, seconds: Array<number>(7).fill(0), billable_seconds: Array<number>(7).fill(0),
      billable_amounts_in_cents: Array<number>(7).fill(0), hourly_rate_in_cents: entry.hourlyRateCents, currency: entry.currency,
    };
  }
  for (const entry of entries) {
    const key = String(entry.projectId ?? 'none');
    let row = rows.get(key);
    if (!row) rows.set(key, (row = emptyWeeklyRow(entry)));
    const day = daysBetween(weekStart, entry.date);
    if (day < 0 || day > 6) continue;
    row.seconds[day]! += entry.seconds;
    if (entry.billable) row.billable_seconds[day]! += entry.seconds;
    row.billable_amounts_in_cents[day]! += entry.amountCents ?? 0;
  }
            days <= 366 -> Resolution.WEEK
            else -> Resolution.MONTH
        }

    /**
     * The range moved by its own length, earlier for a negative [direction]. A range of whole
     * months moves by calendar months, so last month steps to the month before it; any other
     * range moves by its number of days. Port of shiftRange.
     */
    fun shift(direction: Int): ReportRange {
        val step = direction.toLong()
        val months = wholeMonths()
        if (months > 0) {
            val start = from.plusMonths(step * months)
            return ReportRange(start, start.plusMonths(months).minusDays(1))
        }
        return ReportRange(from.plusDays(days * step), to.plusDays(days * step))
    }

    /**
     * The week the weekly report shows for this range: seven days from [firstDayOfWeek], the
     * week that holds [today] when the range does, otherwise the one that holds its first day.
     */
    fun week(today: LocalDate, firstDayOfWeek: DayOfWeek): ReportRange {
        val day = if (today.isBefore(from) || today.isAfter(to)) from else today
        val start = day.with(TemporalAdjusters.previousOrSame(firstDayOfWeek))
        return ReportRange(start, start.plusDays(DAYS_IN_WEEK - 1L))
    }

    /** The number of calendar months the range covers, or 0 when it does not start and end on month edges. */
    private fun wholeMonths(): Long {
        if (from.dayOfMonth != 1 || to != to.with(TemporalAdjusters.lastDayOfMonth())) return 0
        return (to.year - from.year) * 12L + (to.monthValue - from.monthValue) + 1
    }
}

/**
 * The web app's presets, in its order, without All time: that one needs Tokkl's own
 * `/api/app/entries/bounds` and spans up to ten years, more than the Reports API v3 accepts.
 */
enum class RangePreset {
    TODAY,
    YESTERDAY,
    THIS_WEEK,
    LAST_WEEK,
    THIS_MONTH,
    LAST_MONTH,
    LAST_30_DAYS,
    THIS_YEAR,
    LAST_YEAR,
    ;

    /** The preset's days around [today], with weeks that start on [firstDayOfWeek]. Port of presetRange. */
    fun range(today: LocalDate, firstDayOfWeek: DayOfWeek): ReportRange {
        val weekStart = today.with(TemporalAdjusters.previousOrSame(firstDayOfWeek))
        val monthStart = today.withDayOfMonth(1)
        return when (this) {
            TODAY -> ReportRange(today, today)
            YESTERDAY -> today.minusDays(1).let { ReportRange(it, it) }
            THIS_WEEK -> ReportRange(weekStart, weekStart.plusDays(6))
            LAST_WEEK -> ReportRange(weekStart.minusDays(7), weekStart.minusDays(1))
            THIS_MONTH -> ReportRange(monthStart, monthStart.plusMonths(1).minusDays(1))

const SELECT_WITH_STATS = `
  SELECT p.*, c.name AS client_name,
    COALESCE((
      SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN te.stop IS NULL
        THEN unixepoch('now') - unixepoch(te.start)
        ELSE unixepoch(te.stop) - unixepoch(te.start) END)
      FROM time_entries te WHERE te.project_id = p.id AND te.deleted_at IS NULL
    ), 0) AS actual_seconds
  FROM projects p LEFT JOIN clients c ON c.id = p.client_id
`;

export interface ProjectFilter {
  active?: boolean | 'both';
  name?: string;
  clientIds?: number[];
  billable?: boolean;
  sinceIso?: string;
}

export function listProjects(db: Db, wid: number, filter: ProjectFilter = {}): ProjectWithStats[] {
  const where = ['p.workspace_id = ?'];
  const params: Array<string | number> = [wid];
  if (filter.active === true) where.push('p.active = 1');
  if (filter.active === false) where.push('p.active = 0');
  if (filter.billable !== undefined) {
    where.push('p.billable = ?');
    params.push(Number(filter.billable));
  }
  if (filter.name) {
    where.push('instr(lower(p.name), lower(?)) > 0');
    params.push(filter.name);
  }
  if (filter.clientIds?.length) {
    where.push(`p.client_id IN (${filter.clientIds.map(() => '?').join(',')})`);
    params.push(...filter.clientIds);
  }
  if (filter.sinceIso) {
    where.push('p.updated_at >= ?');
    params.push(filter.sinceIso);
  }
  return db.prepare(`${SELECT_WITH_STATS} WHERE ${where.join(' AND ')} ORDER BY p.name COLLATE NOCASE`)
    .all(...params) as unknown as ProjectWithStats[];
}

export function getProject(db: Db, wid: number, id: number): ProjectWithStats {
  const row = db.prepare(`${SELECT_WITH_STATS} WHERE p.workspace_id = ? AND p.id = ?`).get(wid, id) as ProjectWithStats | undefined;
  if (!row) throw notFound('Project not found');
  return row;
}

export function updateProject(db: Db, wid: number, id: number, body: Record<string, unknown>): ProjectWithStats {
  const current = getProject(db, wid, id);
  const name = body.name === undefined ? current.name : requireName(body.name, 'Project name', 255);
  const clientId = resolveClientId(db, wid, body, current.client_id);
  assertUniqueName(db, wid, clientId, name, id);
  const pick = <T>(value: T | undefined, fallback: T): T => (value === undefined ? fallback : value);
  db.prepare(`
    UPDATE projects SET client_id = ?, name = ?, color = ?, active = ?, is_private = ?, billable = ?,
      estimated_hours = ?, rate = ?, currency = ?, fixed_fee = ?, start_date = ?, end_date = ?, template = ?,
      updated_at = ?
    WHERE id = ?
  `).run(
    clientId, name, parseColor(body.color, current.color),
    Number(pick(optionalBool(body.active, 'active'), asBool(current.active))),
    Number(pick(optionalBool(body.is_private, 'is_private'), asBool(current.is_private))),
    Number(pick(optionalBool(body.billable, 'billable'), asBool(current.billable))),
    pick(optionalNumber(body.estimated_hours, 'estimated_hours'), current.estimated_hours),
    pick(optionalRate(body.rate, 'rate'), current.rate),
    parseCurrency(body.currency, current.currency),
    pick(optionalNumber(body.fixed_fee, 'fixed_fee'), current.fixed_fee),
    parseDate(body.start_date, 'start_date', current.start_date),
    parseDate(body.end_date, 'end_date', current.end_date),
    Number(pick(optionalBool(body.template, 'template'), asBool(current.template))),
    nowIso(), id,
  );
  return getProject(db, wid, id);
}

/** Deletes a project. Its time entries are kept without a project unless `deleteEntries` is set. */
export function deleteProject(db: Db, wid: number, id: number, deleteEntries: boolean): void {
  getProject(db, wid, id);
  const now = nowIso();
  if (deleteEntries) {
    db.prepare('UPDATE time_entries SET deleted_at = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE project_id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL').run(now, now, id);
  } else {
    db.prepare('UPDATE time_entries SET updated_at = ? WHERE project_id = ?').run(now, id);
  }
  db.prepare('DELETE FROM projects WHERE id = ?').run(id);
}

function projectStatus(row: ProjectRow): string {
  if (!asBool(row.active)) return 'archived';
  const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  if (row.start_date && row.start_date > today) return 'upcoming';
  if (row.end_date && row.end_date < today) return 'ended';
  return 'active';
}

/** Invalidates several query keys at once so every page that shows the data refetches it. */
export function useInvalidate(): (...queryKeys: readonly QueryKey[]) => Promise<void> {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  return async (...queryKeys) => {
    await Promise.all(queryKeys.map((queryKey) => qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey })));
  };
}

/** Workspace-scoped path builder: `wsPath(wid, 'projects', 3)` gives `/api/v9/workspaces/{wid}/projects/3`. */
export function wsPath(wid: number, ...segments: Array<string | number>): string {
  return [`${V9}/workspaces/${wid}`, ...segments].join('/');

interface ActionOptions<TVars, TResult> {
  mutationFn: (vars: TVars) => Promise<TResult>;
  /** Query keys to refresh after success. */
  invalidate?: readonly QueryKey[];
  /** Toast shown after success. */
  success?: string | ((result: TResult, vars: TVars) => string);
  onSuccess?: (result: TResult, vars: TVars) => void;
  /** Shows a server error somewhere else, such as next to the field that caused it, instead of a toast. */
  onError?: (error: Error, vars: TVars) => void;
}

/**
 * A mutation that refreshes the given queries, shows a success toast and reports server errors
 * through `toast.error` (or `onError`), so callers only describe what the action does.
 */
export function useAction<TVars = void, TResult = unknown>(options: ActionOptions<TVars, TResult>) {
  const toast = useToast();
  const invalidate = useInvalidate();
  return useMutation<TResult, Error, TVars>({
    mutationFn: options.mutationFn,
    onSuccess: (result, vars) => {
      void invalidate(...(options.invalidate ?? []));
      const message = typeof options.success === 'function' ? options.success(result, vars) : options.success;
      if (message) toast.show(message);
      options.onSuccess?.(result, vars);
    },
    onError: (error, vars) => (options.onError ? options.onError(error, vars) : toast.error(error)),
  });
}

/**
 * Tasks of one project, archived ones included. The key starts with `keys.tasks`, so invalidating
 * `keys.tasks` refreshes it too.
 */
export function useProjectTasks(projectId: number | null) {
  const wid = useWid();
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: [...keys.tasks, 'project', projectId],
    queryFn: () => api.get<Task[]>(`${wsPath(wid, 'projects', projectId ?? 0, 'tasks')}?active=both`),
    enabled: wid > 0 && projectId !== null,
  });
}

/** Toggl reports `tracked_seconds` in milliseconds despite the name; the server copies that quirk. */
export function taskTrackedSeconds(task: Task): number {
  return Math.floor(task.tracked_seconds / 1000);
}

/** Deleted entries, newest deletion first. The server returns at most 1000. */
export function useTrash() {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: keys.trash,
    queryFn: () => api.get<TimeEntry[]>('/api/app/trash'),
  });
}

/** Parses an optional non-negative number field. Empty means null; anything invalid means undefined. */
export function parseOptionalAmount(raw: string): number | null | undefined {
  const text = raw.trim().replace(',', '.');
  if (text === '') return null;
  const value = Number(text);
  return Number.isFinite(value) && value >= 0 ? value : undefined;
}

export function includesText(haystack: string | null | undefined, query: string): boolean {
  return (haystack ?? '').toLowerCase().includes(query.trim().toLowerCase());
}

    /** `GET /api/v9/me` has no `time_resolution_minutes`, as on Toggl Track. */
    @Test
    fun meWithoutTimeResolutionRefreshesWithNoSnapping() {
        server.enqueue(json(MADRID_MONDAY))
        server.enqueue(json(IMPROVED))
        val stored = AccountSettings("UTC", DayOfWeek.SUNDAY, timeResolutionMinutes = 5.0)
        val source = source(initial = stored)

        val refresh = source.refresh()

        assertTrue("the refresh finished", refresh.isCompleted)
        assertEquals("/api/v9/me", server.takeRequest().url.encodedPath)
        assertEquals("/api/v9/me/preferences", server.takeRequest().url.encodedPath)
        assertEquals(MADRID_MONDAY_SETTINGS, source.state.value)
        assertEquals(listOf(MADRID_MONDAY_SETTINGS), saved)
        val start = Instant.parse("2026-10-18T10:10:07Z")
        val stop = Instant.parse("2026-10-18T10:52:41Z")
        assertEquals(SnappedSpan(start, stop), source.state.value!!.time()!!.snapUnsent(start, stop))
    }

    @Test
    fun aRefreshWhileOneRunsJoinsItAndSendsNoSecondRequest() {
        server.enqueue(json(MADRID_MONDAY))
        server.enqueue(json(IMPROVED))
        server.enqueue(json(MADRID_MONDAY))
        server.enqueue(json(IMPROVED))
        // Holds each refresh until the test runs it.
        val queued = ArrayDeque<Runnable>()
        val source = source(initial = null, io = Executor { queued += it }.asCoroutineDispatcher())

        val first = source.refresh()
        val second = source.refresh()

        assertSame("the second call gets the running refresh", first, second)
        assertEquals("one refresh waits to run", 1, queued.size)
        queued.removeFirst().run()
        assertTrue("the refresh finished", first.isCompleted)
        assertEquals("one /me and one /me/preferences", 2, server.requestCount)
        assertEquals(MADRID_MONDAY_SETTINGS, source.state.value)

        val next = source.refresh()

        assertNotSame("a call after the refresh finished starts a new one", first, next)
        queued.removeFirst().run()
        assertTrue("the new refresh finished", next.isCompleted)
        assertEquals(4, server.requestCount)
    }

        assertEquals(2, server.requestCount)
        assertEquals(signedIn, source.state.value)
        assertEquals("only sign-in wrote", listOf(signedIn), saved)
    }

/** The value, or an error that names [call] and the failure alone, so no body or secret lands in it. */
fun <T> ApiResult<T>.orFail(call: String): T =
    when (this) {
        is ApiResult.Success -> value
        is ApiResult.Failure -> {
            val error = error
            val reason = if (error is ApiError.Http) "HTTP ${error.status}" else error::class.simpleName
            throw AssertionError("$call failed: $reason")
        }
    }

app/src/androidTest/java/com/github/e0ipso/tokkl/trust/CertificateHostMismatchWhileSignedInTest.kt
package com.github.e0ipso.tokkl.trust

import android.content.Context
import androidx.annotation.StringRes
import androidx.compose.ui.test.SemanticsMatcher
import androidx.compose.ui.test.assertIsDisplayed
import androidx.compose.ui.test.hasText
import androidx.compose.ui.test.junit4.v2.createAndroidComposeRule
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import com.github.e0ipso.tokkl.LoopbackRelay
import com.github.e0ipso.tokkl.MainActivity
import com.github.e0ipso.tokkl.R
import com.github.e0ipso.tokkl.SessionRule
import com.github.e0ipso.tokkl.SignedOut
import com.github.e0ipso.tokkl.TokklTestServer
import com.github.e0ipso.tokkl.api.ApiError
import com.github.e0ipso.tokkl.api.ApiResult
import com.github.e0ipso.tokkl.api.ServerUrl
import com.github.e0ipso.tokkl.awaitTimerPage
import com.github.e0ipso.tokkl.session.ServerTrustStore
import com.github.e0ipso.tokkl.session.Session
import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonObject
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Rule
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.rules.ExternalResource
import org.junit.rules.RuleChain

/**
 * A stored session for a server whose certificate does not name the host in its URL: the
 * harness's TLS proxy under `localhost`, while its certificate names only the IP addresses
 * 10.0.2.2 and 127.0.0.1. A relay on the phone's loopback carries the connection to the proxy,
 * so the app's own client and trust checks see the proxy's certificate. No answer to a prompt
 * fixes that, so the Timer page offers none.
 */
@SignedOut
class CertificateHostMismatchWhileSignedInTest {

    private val context: Context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
    private val proxy = TokklTestServer.tlsUrl.api("me")
    private val relay = LoopbackRelay(proxy.host, proxy.port)
    private val server = ServerUrl.parse("https://$HOST:${relay.localPort}") ?: error("not a URL")
    private val composeRule = createAndroidComposeRule<MainActivity>()

    @get:Rule
    val rules: RuleChain = RuleChain.outerRule(SessionRule())
        .around(object : ExternalResource() {
            override fun before() {
[credential-related line omitted]
            }

            override fun after() {
                relay.close()
            }
        })
        .around(composeRule)

    @Test
    fun theNoticeNamesTheHostAndTheFixAndNothingIsPinned() {
        composeRule.awaitTimerPage()

        val notice = context.getString(R.string.trust_refused_certificate_host, HOST)
        composeRule.waitUntil("the host name notice shows", NETWORK_TIMEOUT_MS) { exists(hasText(notice)) }
        composeRule.onNode(hasText(notice)).assertIsDisplayed()
        assertFalse("the notice offers to review the connection", exists(hasText(string(R.string.trust_refused_review))))
        assertFalse("a certificate prompt shows", exists(hasText(string(R.string.sign_in_certificate_title))))
        assertFalse("a certificate prompt shows", exists(hasText(string(R.string.sign_in_certificate_changed_title))))
        assertEquals(ApiError.CertificateHostMismatch(HOST), (me() as? ApiResult.Failure)?.error)
        assertNull("a pin for $HOST", ServerTrustStore(context).pinnedSha256(HOST, relay.localPort))
        assertNull("a pin for the proxy", ServerTrustStore(context).pinnedSha256(proxy.host, proxy.port))
    }

    /** `GET /api/v9/me` with the stored session's client, as the app sends it. */
    private fun me(): ApiResult<JsonObject> {
        val client = Session(context).client() ?: throw AssertionError("no stored session")
        return client.get(server.api("me"), JsonObject.serializer())
    }

    private fun exists(matcher: SemanticsMatcher): Boolean =
        composeRule.onAllNodes(matcher).fetchSemanticsNodes().isNotEmpty()

    private fun string(@StringRes id: Int): String = context.getString(id)

    private companion object {
        /** A name the phone resolves to its loopback, which the certificate does not name. */
        const val HOST = "localhost"

        const val NETWORK_TIMEOUT_MS = 15_000L
    }
}


app/src/test/java/com/github/e0ipso/tokkl/ui/theme/NavigationBarColoursTest.kt
package com.github.e0ipso.tokkl.ui.theme

import androidx.compose.material3.ColorScheme
import androidx.compose.ui.text.font.FontWeight
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNotEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Test

/** The bottom bar item colours Tokkl sets over Material 3's. ThemeContrastTest checks their contrast. */
class NavigationBarColoursTest {

    @Test
    fun lightItemsFollowTheDecision() = assertDecision(TokklLightColorScheme)

    @Test
    fun darkItemsFollowTheDecision() = assertDecision(TokklDarkColorScheme)

    @Test
    fun onlyTheActiveLabelIsBold() {
        assertEquals(FontWeight(700), navigationBarLabelWeight(selected = true))
        assertNull(navigationBarLabelWeight(selected = false))
    }

    private fun assertDecision(s: ColorScheme) {
        val item = navigationBarItemColors(s)
        assertEquals(s.primary, item.selectedIndicatorColor)
        assertEquals(s.onPrimary, item.selectedIconColor)
        assertEquals(s.primary, item.selectedTextColor)
        assertEquals(s.onSurfaceVariant, item.unselectedIconColor)
        assertEquals(s.onSurfaceVariant, item.unselectedTextColor)
        // Material 3's default indicator, which the colour scheme still maps to --state-selected.
        assertNotEquals(s.secondaryContainer, item.selectedIndicatorColor)
    }
}

- severity: major
  confidence: high
  category: defect
  ticket: TKA-0027
  location: app/src/main/java/com/github/e0ipso/tokkl/TokklApplication.kt:106
  problem: A stale refresh can overwrite an entry immediately after its queued change succeeds.
  evidence: If a refresh reads a running entry before a queued Stop reaches the server, then commits after the sender removes that change, its snapshot restores the running state; onSent joins that existing refresh instead of scheduling a fresh read.
  fix: Use refreshAfterChange() after a successful drain.

- severity: major
  confidence: high
  category: defect
  ticket: TKA-0029
  location: app/src/main/java/com/github/e0ipso/tokkl/history/HistoryModel.kt:144
  problem: Advancing the cache window leaves a permanent gap between cached history and previously loaded pages.
  evidence: Load older history on October 19, when the cache begins October 6, then resume the same activity on October 20; refresh prunes October 6, but older pages end before October 6 and subsequent requests continue backwards from their existing cursor.
  fix: Rebase older-history coverage when the cache window advances and fetch the newly uncovered days.

- severity: major
  confidence: high
  category: requirement
  ticket: TKA-0030
  location: app/src/main/java/com/github/e0ipso/tokkl/calendar/CalendarModel.kt:165
  problem: Treating a week as fully cached omits entries crossing into its first day from outside the cache.
  evidence: On Sunday October 25 with Monday week start, the cache begins October 12; an entry from October 11 at 23:00 through October 12 at 01:00 is excluded from the cache, and opening the October 12 week skips fetching it even online.
  fix: Retain or fetch entries that overlap the first cached calendar day.

- severity: major
  confidence: high
  category: requirement
  ticket: TKA-0030
  location: app/src/main/java/com/github/e0ipso/tokkl/calendar/CalendarModel.kt:178
  problem: The one-day lookback omits valid longer entries overlapping an uncached week.
  evidence: An entry from September 26 at 23:00 through September 28 at 01:00 is missing from the September 28 week because its request includes only starts on or after September 27.
  fix: Fetch starts far enough back to cover supported entry durations, then filter by overlap.

- severity: major
  confidence: high
  category: defect
  ticket: TKA-0030
  location: app/src/main/java/com/github/e0ipso/tokkl/calendar/CalendarModel.kt:167
  problem: Successfully loaded older weeks never refresh during the model’s lifetime.
  evidence: Load a September week, background the app, delete an entry through the web app, and return; the foreground refresh updates only the recent cache, while WeekSource.Loaded prevents another calendar request, so the deleted block remains even after revisiting that week.
  fix: Invalidate or reload fetched weeks when the app returns to the foreground.
